ITEM 1 | Long curled strip with crisp-looking edges, golden-brown to reddish-brown with darker caramelized spots, glossy and slightly oily sheen, flat ribbon shape with wavy, ruffled edges and visible striated fat and lean layers, roughly 12 cm long and 2 cm wide, lying across the upper right of the plate | 14
ITEM 2 | Curved, folded strip with reddish-brown lean band and paler fatty streaks, slightly glossy, ruffled edges, about 9 cm long and 1.5 cm wide, draped over the top center of the plate and touching item 1 | 9
ITEM 3 | Thick, partly overlapping pair of strips, dark amber to reddish-brown with a rendered, glossy sheen, flat with crinkled edges, about 10 cm long and 2 cm wide, lying in the lower center of the plate beside a small curled piece | 13
ITEM 4 | Small curled piece with tight spiral shape, orange-brown with darker edges, matte to slightly glossy, about 4 cm long and 1 cm wide, sitting at the left edge of the cluster on the white plate | 3
ITEM 5 | Smeared pinkish-red residue and thin yellowish grease film on the white plate surface around the strips, flat and thin, covering a few square centimeters near the center | 2
